12.t: Working with data: pulse and fitness
q: What was Student A’s pulse straight after exercise?
How long did Student B take to return to a resting pulse?
Which student is fitter? Give two pieces of evidence.
Student B: lower resting pulse (64 vs 72), smaller rise (128 vs 150) and faster recovery.
Suggest two variables that should be controlled to make this a fair comparison.
E.g. the same exercise (step height, rate, time), same time of day, no caffeine, same measuring method.
